title: bgp-neighbors
description: BGP peers the device reports, one row per peer. The identity is the peer's own router-id, which is what lets a crawl recognise a device it has already visited; a peer's address alone cannot do that, because one device answers at many addresses.

identity.description: The peer's router-id, as the peer reports it.

address.description: The address the session is established to, without any TCP port.

state.description: Session state, such as established or idle.
